'honeycomb pattern' (which implies clustered cysts with thick walls typically seen in end-stage fibrosis) and from diffuse lower-lobe predominant disease.", "Confirm the specific combination of subpleural cysts and linear markings rather than generic interstitial changes or absence of cysts."]}, {"category": "characterization", "trigger": "When evaluating a chest radiograph with an azygos
